INFORMATION

Accessibility

Our aim

We want this website to be usable by as many people as possible, including visitors who use keyboards, screen readers, zoom or reduced-motion settings.

What we have done

  • Provided keyboard-accessible navigation and controls.
  • Added visible focus states and a skip-to-content link.
  • Used semantic headings and labelled interactive controls.
  • Provided alternative text for meaningful images.
  • Supported reduced-motion preferences.
  • Designed the site to adapt to mobile and desktop screen sizes.

Need help?

If you have difficulty using any part of this website or need restaurant information in another format, email siciliabellamgarr@gmail.com or call +356 2156 3588. We will do our best to help.

Feedback

If you notice an accessibility problem, please contact us using the details above and tell us which page or feature caused difficulty.
